name: MEC Company Ltd.
blurb: MEC Company Ltd. is a Japanese company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals and electronic materials. The company provides products such as plating chemicals, surface treatment agents, and semiconductor-related materials. It serves various industries including automotive, electronics, and construction, and has a notable presence in the Japanese market.
